title: Entry Systems Garage Doors Gates
description: entrysystems.com Entry Systems Garage Doors & Gates 3rd-generation family business in Laguna Hills, CA (with a second design center in Tustin, opened 2024) — servicing garage doors and automated gates across South Orange County since 1972. Legal entity: Laguna Niguel Garage Door Service, Inc.; CA contractor license #916334 (class D28, active through 2028, clear record), bonded and insured. Services: garage door repair/installation (CHI, Amarr, Clopay), openers (Genie, Liftmaster, smart home), swing/slide gates (DoorKing, Elite, Eagle, solar), telephone entry systems, welding, and maintenance — same-day emergency service typical.
